title: FrameEnvelope
description: C1 Gateway -> C2 Preprocessing. A single raw frame received from smartphone/simulator, wrapped with tracing metadata.

trace_id.description: Unique id for this frame's end-to-end trace. Generated by C1. TODO: UUID v4 vs ULID.

session_id.description: Streaming session id (one per client connection).

frame_id.description: Monotonically increasing frame index within a session. Generated by C1.

captured_at_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the frame was captured on the client. TODO: client/server clock sync strategy.

format.description: Encoding of the frame payload. TODO: finalize supported formats.

gateway_received_at_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when C1 received the frame.

image_b64.description: TODO: frame payload transport is not decided (base64 in JSON vs. binary/multipart vs. shared reference).
